prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical retro travel-poster collage for a family trip to Taiwan / Taipei / Jiufen, combining bold typography, risograph texture, manga character art, food cutouts, tickets, maps, and landmark photography.

Canvas: Tall vertical poster, roughly 9:16 aspect ratio, cream paper background with distressed print grain, halftone dots, imperfect ink registration, rough collage edges, and a limited palette of vermilion red, deep navy blue, teal green, cream, and small black accents.

Layout: Use enormous cropped red block letters spelling TAIWAN across the entire upper background, so large that the letters run off the edges. Layer a teal-blue Taipei 101 skyscraper near the upper left-center, overlapping the letters. Add a white Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall photo block at lower left of the skyline area, a vertical night-market lantern street photo in the center, a small tea-table still life near the upper right-center, and a large blue Jiufen night street photo panel on the mid-right. Place a pale green street map diagonally across the middle-left, partly under the character and food. Add a tilted boarding-pass/ticket collage in the lower-left quadrant. Put the illustrated character in the lower center foreground, standing over a dark navy ground shape.

Main subject: A cute manga-style young traveler girl seen full body from behind but turning her head toward the viewer. She has short brown bob hair, oversized round glasses, soft curious expression, and wears a fluffy white sheep-like hat with curled ram-horn shapes. Outfit: simple oversized white short-sleeve dress or smock coat, white socks, chunky white lace-up boots, small backpack straps visible. Keep the drawing mostly cream and navy linework with light halftone shading, matching the printed collage aesthetic.

Counted visible travel and food collage elements: Include exactly 6 landmark/photo/map/ticket elements: 1 Taipei 101 skyscraper, 1 Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall image, 1 night-market lantern alley image, 1 tea table still life, 1 Jiufen night street image, and 1 Taipei street map. Include exactly 5 food/drink cutouts in the lower half: 1 red bamboo steamer of soup dumplings, 1 bowl of noodles, 1 mound of shaved ice dessert, 1 plastic cup of bubble tea with straw, and 1 folded paper snack cup containing a stuffed bun or sandwich.

Text content: Add vertical dark-blue Japanese text near the skyscraper reading 台北／九份. On the right side, set stacked itinerary text in narrow uppercase navy: “3 NIGHTS”, “4 DAYS”, “FAMILY”, a circled “5”, then “EAT”, “WALK”, “TEA”, separated by thin horizontal rules. On the tilted ticket at lower left, include “TYO TOKYO →”, large “TPE”, “TAIPEI”, “SONGSHAN AIRPORT”, a tiny airplane icon, and “3 NIGHTS 4 DAYS”. At bottom right, include a small list in navy uppercase: “TAIPEI 101”, “CHIANG KAI-SHEK MEMORIAL HALL”, “NATIONAL PALACE MUSEUM”, “NIGHT MARKET”, “JIUFEN”, “TAIWAN TEA”.

Visual style: Japanese editorial cover design, MiriCanvas-style travel zine, vintage screenprint, risograph poster, collage with transparent color overlays, high contrast, weathered ink, halftone shading, slightly misaligned cyan/red layers, playful yet sophisticated.

Constraints: Keep all text legible enough to read, avoid photorealistic rendering of the character, avoid modern glossy gradients, no watermark, no extra people, no additional food items beyond the 5 counted cutouts, and maintain the bold red TAIWAN typography dominating the composition.

promptZh:
目标：为 台湾 / 台北 / 九份 的家庭旅行创作一张垂直的复古旅行海报拼贴画，结合醒目的排版、孔版印刷纹理、漫画角色艺术、美食剪贴画、票据、地图和地标摄影。

画布：高垂直海报，比例约为 9:16，奶油色纸张背景，带有磨损的印刷颗粒感、半色调网点、不完美的套色效果、粗糙的拼贴边缘，以及朱红色、深海军蓝、青绿色、奶油色和少量黑色点缀的有限调色板。

布局：使用巨大的红色块状字母拼写 TAIWAN，横跨整个上方背景，字母大到超出边缘。在左上方中心附近叠加一个青蓝色的台北 101 大楼，与字母重叠。在天际线区域的左下方添加一个白色的中正纪念堂照片块，中心放置一张夜市灯笼街的照片，右上中心附近放置一张茶桌静物图，右侧中部放置一张大型蓝色九份夜街照片面板。将一张淡绿色的街道地图斜向放置在左中部，部分位于角色和食物下方。在左下象限添加一张倾斜的登机牌/票据拼贴。将插画角色放置在前景底部中心，站在深海军蓝色的地面形状上。

主体：一位可爱的漫画风年轻女性旅行者，全身背影但头部转向观众。她留着棕色短波波头，戴着超大圆框眼镜，表情柔和好奇，戴着一顶毛茸茸的白色羊形帽子，带有卷曲的羊角形状。服装：简约的超大号白色短袖连衣裙或罩衫，白色袜子，厚底白色系带靴，可见小背包肩带。绘画风格保持奶油色和海军蓝线条，带有轻微的半色调阴影，与印刷拼贴的美学相匹配。

可见旅行和美食拼贴元素计数：包含 6 个地标/照片/地图/票据元素：1 个台北 101 大楼、1 张中正纪念堂图片、1 张夜市灯笼巷图片、1 张茶桌静物图、1 张九份夜街图片和 1 张台北街道地图。在下半部分包含 5 个美食/饮品剪贴画：1 笼红色竹蒸笼小笼包、1 碗面条、1 份刨冰甜点、1 杯带吸管的珍珠奶茶，以及 1 个装有馅饼或三明治的折叠纸质零食杯。

文本内容：在摩天大楼附近添加垂直的深蓝色日文文本，内容为 台北／九份。在右侧，以窄体大写海军蓝字体堆叠行程文本：“3 NIGHTS”、“4 DAYS”、“FAMILY”，一个圆圈“5”，然后是“EAT”、“WALK”、“TEA”，由细横线分隔。在左下角的倾斜票据上，包含“TYO TOKYO →”、大号“TPE”、“TAIPEI”、“SONGSHAN AIRPORT”、一个小飞机图标和“3 NIGHTS 4 DAYS”。在右下角，包含一个海军蓝大写字母的小列表：“TAIPEI 101”、“CHIANG KAI-SHEK MEMORIAL HALL”、“NATIONAL PALACE MUSEUM”、“NIGHT MARKET”、“JIUFEN”、“TAIWAN TEA”。

视觉风格：日式编辑封面设计、MiriCanvas 风格旅行杂志、复古丝网印刷、孔版印刷海报、带有透明色彩叠加的拼贴画、高对比度、风化墨迹、半色调阴影、轻微错位的青色/红色层，既俏皮又精致。

约束：保持所有文本清晰可读，避免角色呈现照片级真实感，避免现代光泽渐变，无水印，无额外人物，除 5 个计数剪贴画外无额外食物，并保持醒目的红色 TAIWAN 排版占据构图主导地位。
